'''Lima Starcourt''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] who spent most of her career on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She later moved to [[Ostor]] and became one of the leaders of the Separatist group. When the Galactic Empire launched a military offensive to suppress the influence of the Separatists on Ostor, Starcourt and the other Separatist leaders helped establish a defense strategy. This allowed the Separatist general [[Atticus Farstar]] to almost completely wipe out a first wave of Imperial forces. However, the defense did not stand up to a second wave of attacks. Starcourt and the other leaders were killed during the course of the battle.
